caption: The drawing depicts a metallic container with a cylindrical body and a domed lid featuring a spherical knob on top. The container is predominantly a dark greyish-green color with some lighter areas suggestive of worn or reflective metal. A handle, also dark, is attached to the left side of the body, curving outward and downward. On the front of the container, there is a rectangular panel or door with a lighter, off-white or beige color, framed by the same dark metal as the main body. A latch or locking mechanism is visible on the front of the body, securing the door or panel. Above the container's body, the lid has ribbed or fluted segments converging at the central knob. The object is centered against a plain, light beige background with minimal markings, and the name "TRISE CAMPBELL GERKE" appears written in small, grey text below the container. There are faint red stains on the lower right portion of the background.
title: Lantern
